start_greeting:
Hi! I'm a chess game analysis bot.

Send me a PGN file, a game in PGN text, or a link to a game on chess.com / lichess.org — I'll parse the moves.

See /help for the full list of commands.
help_text:
Available commands:
/start — greeting and a short description of the bot
/help — this list of commands
/language — choose the interface language
/balance — today's remaining game analyses
/subscribe — subscribe or upgrade your plan

You can also just send a PGN file, a game in PGN text, or a link to a game on chess.com / lichess.org.
game_parse_error: Could not recognize the game. Please send a PGN file, PGN text, or a link to a game on chess.com/lichess.org.
link_unsupported: This link wasn't recognized as chess.com or lichess.org.
game_fetch_error_private: This game is private and can't be accessed.
game_fetch_error_unsupported: Couldn't get the moves for this game: the service returned an unsupported response format.
game_fetch_error_network: Couldn't reach the service. Please try again later.
analyzing: Analyzing the game with the engine, this may take a moment...
engine_error: Couldn't analyze the game with the engine. Please try again later.
no_critical_moments: No critical mistakes (loss over 100 centipawns) found — the game was played evenly.
limit_exceeded: You've reached today's game analysis limit ({limit} per day). Subscribe or upgrade your plan — /subscribe.
balance_status:
Game analyses left today: {remaining} of {limit}.
Current plan: {tier}.
invoice_description: "{tier}" subscription for {days} days — a higher daily game analysis limit.
subscription_activated: "{tier}" subscription activated for {days} days. See /balance for your updated limit.
